body:
- **Project:** filemark — a Chrome extension (MV3) that renders
  `.md`, `.mdx`, `.json`, `.jsonc`, `.sql`, `.prisma`, `.dbml` locally
  with first-class interactive features.
- **Scope framing:** personal power-tool for the author. Not a
  collaboration platform; not a cloud product. Local-first, MV3-native,
  zero tracking.
- **Unique selling point:** markdown is programmable — fenced `csv`
  blocks become sortable/filterable/groupable/exportable datagrids;
  task checkboxes persist; ER diagrams render inline; all without any
  JavaScript evaluation (MV3 CSP compliant).

---
